description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing stateful processing in Spark Structured Streaming, including state management (ValueState, ListState, MapState), timer handling, and an abstract base class for user-defined stateful processors.

classes.name: ValueState
classes.description: Manages a single value state for a key, allowing existence check, get, update, and clear operations.

classes.name: TimerValues
classes.description: Provides access to processing and watermark times for the current batch.

classes.name: ExpiredTimerInfo
classes.description: Provides access to the expiry time of a timer that has expired.

classes.name: ListState
classes.description: Manages list-based state for a key, supporting existence check, get, put, append, and clear.

classes.name: MapState
classes.description: Manages map-based state for a key, supporting existence check, get, update, key iteration, value iteration, removal, and clear.

classes.name: StatefulProcessorHandle
classes.description: Provides methods to create or access different types of state (value, list, map) and timer operations for a user-defined processor.

classes.name: StatefulProcessor
classes.description: Abstract base class for user-defined stateful processing logic, including initialization, input handling, timer handling, cleanup, and optional initial state processing.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if the state exists.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the state with a new value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the state.

methods.name: getCurrentProcessingTimeInMs
methods.description: Returns the current processing time in milliseconds.

methods.name: getCurrentWatermarkInMs
methods.description: Returns the current watermark in milliseconds.

methods.name: getExpiryTimeInMs
methods.description: Returns the expiry time of an expired timer.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Sets the list state to new values.

methods.name: appendValue
methods.description: Appends a value to the list state.

methods.name: appendList
methods.description: Appends multiple values to the list state.

methods.name: removeKey
methods.description: Removes a key from the map state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key in the map state.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the map state.

methods.name: updateValue
methods.description: Updates the value for a key in the map state.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over key-value pairs in the map state.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns an iterator over keys in the map state.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an iterator over values in the map state.

methods.name: registerTimer
methods.description: Registers a timer for a specific expiry timestamp.

methods.name: deleteTimer
methods.description: Deletes a timer for a specific expiry timestamp.

methods.name: listTimers
methods.description: Lists all timers' expiry timestamps.

methods.name: deleteIfExists
methods.description: Deletes a state variable if it exists.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the user-defined stateful processor, called once at startup.

methods.name: handleInputRows
methods.description: Processes input rows for a given key, with support for pandas or Row data types.

methods.name: handleExpiredTimer
methods.description: Handles expired timers, optional to implement.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations, called at the end.

methods.name: handleInitialState
methods.description: Optional method to process initial state at first batch.
